name: Shopify
description: Connect your Shopify store so the agent can look up orders, customers, and products, track shipments, and handle cancellations, refunds, and returns.

shopify_get_shop.label: Get Store Info
shopify_get_shop.description: Get basic information about the connected store (name, domain, plan, currency).

shopify_get_order.label: Get Order
shopify_get_order.description: Get an order's items, totals, shipping address, tracking, and support eligibility.

shopify_get_order_by_name.label: Get Order by Number
shopify_get_order_by_name.description: Look up an order by its order number (e.g. #1001).

shopify_list_customer_orders.label: List Customer Orders
shopify_list_customer_orders.description: List a customer's orders, most recent first.

shopify_get_order_tracking.label: Get Order Tracking
shopify_get_order_tracking.description: Get an order's fulfillment and shipment tracking status.

shopify_update_order_shipping_address.label: Update Order Shipping Address
shopify_update_order_shipping_address.description: Change where an undispatched order will ship. Refuses once fulfillment has started.

shopify_add_order_note.label: Add Order Note
shopify_add_order_note.description: Add to the internal note on an order. Existing notes are kept.

shopify_calculate_refund.label: Calculate Refund
shopify_calculate_refund.description: Preview the correct refund amounts for an order before executing it.

shopify_create_refund.label: Create Refund
shopify_create_refund.description: Execute a refund for an order, bounded by Shopify's maximum refundable amount.

shopify_cancel_order.label: Cancel Order
shopify_cancel_order.description: Cancel an order before it ships, optionally restocking items, refunding, and notifying the customer. Refuses once anything has shipped.

shopify_get_returnable_items.label: Get Returnable Items
shopify_get_returnable_items.description: List the fulfilled items on an order that are eligible for a return.

shopify_create_return.label: Create Return
shopify_create_return.description: Open a return for fulfilled items on an order. Refunds are handled separately.

shopify_find_customer.label: Find Customer
shopify_find_customer.description: Find customers by email address and/or phone number.

shopify_get_customer.label: Get Customer
shopify_get_customer.description: Get a customer's details including their most recent orders.

shopify_update_customer.label: Update Customer
shopify_update_customer.description: Update a customer's basic profile fields.

shopify_update_customer_address.label: Update Customer Address
shopify_update_customer_address.description: Update a saved address on the customer's profile (does not change existing orders).

shopify_get_product.label: Get Product
shopify_get_product.description: Get a single product by id, including its variants.

shopify_get_product_by_handle.label: Get Product by Handle
shopify_get_product_by_handle.description: Get a single product by its URL handle, including its variants.

shopify_search_products.label: Search Products
shopify_search_products.description: Search the store's products by title.

shopify_check_inventory.label: Check Inventory
shopify_check_inventory.description: Check stock levels for a product variant by id or SKU across all locations.

shopify_create_coupon.label: Create Goodwill Coupon
shopify_create_coupon.description: Create a single-use apology discount code for one customer, within the merchant's percentage or amount cap.

shopify_swap_order_item.label: Swap Order Item
shopify_swap_order_item.description: Before dispatch, swap an item for another size or colour of the same product. Same price or lower, in stock only.

shopify_create_exchange.label: Create Exchange
shopify_create_exchange.description: After delivery, exchange items for other variants. Refuses when the shopper would owe money or a replacement is out of stock.

couponsEnabled.label: Allow goodwill coupons
couponsEnabled.description: Let the agent create single-use apology discount codes, only usable by that customer, within the caps below. A coupon above the cap waits for a team member to approve it.

couponMaxPercent.label: Coupon cap: maximum percentage
couponMaxPercent.description: Largest percentage discount the agent may give (0 turns percentage coupons off).

couponMaxAmount.label: Coupon cap: maximum fixed amount
couponMaxAmount.description: Largest fixed discount in your shop currency (0 or empty turns fixed-amount coupons off).

couponMaxDays.label: Coupon validity (days)
couponMaxDays.description: Codes the agent creates expire after at most this many days.

staleTrackingDomesticDays.label: Stale tracking: domestic (days)
staleTrackingDomesticDays.description: Treat a domestic shipment as stuck when its tracking has not moved for more than this many days.

staleTrackingInternationalDays.label: Stale tracking: international (days)
staleTrackingInternationalDays.description: Treat an international shipment as stuck when its tracking has not moved for more than this many days.
